author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಡವ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಹ ಬದುಕ ಪರಿಕಿಸುವ ಪರಶಕ್ತಿ
ಪಡೆದೆ ತೀರುವ ಸಾಲ ಲಾಭಗಳು ಸೇರಿ
ಅಡಮಾನವಿಹ ದೇಹ ಬಾಧೆಗಳ ಜಯಿಸುತಿರೆ
ಬಿಡುಗಡೆಯೊ ಸಾಲದಿಂ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The supreme power that lent you life puts it to the test;
you must repay the loan you took, with interest;
when the mortgaged body conquers its troubles,
you are released from the debt, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life is a loan from a higher power, to be repaid with interest through our conduct. Overcoming the trials of the body is how the debt is cleared.
